newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends up as dlr supply improves.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends up as dlr supply improves.

text.p: A fresh inflow of remittances improved the supply of dollars in the interbank market on Tuesday, helping the Bangladesh taka to close firmer at 43.7495/7500, dealers said.
The taka opened at Monday's closing level but had edged up by midday.
"(Dollar) supply was comfortable compared to the past several sessions. It was mostly because of some inward remittances (from wage earners)," said one dealer.
Interbank call money rates closed unchanged at six to seven percent.
